purpose: Recompute the unchanged C09 route-conditioned geometry qualification from original frozen inputs in a new immutable directory after V1R was interrupted by a host reboot before runner finalization.

approval.scope: Exactly one V1R2 full replacement over the same 10 C09 worlds, 1027 edges, 2054 traversals, 71 windows, 15833 frames and 639 patches under the unchanged 24 active hour, 4 GiB RAM and 8 GiB disk limits. V1R partial outputs are excluded and may not be read or reused. A sleep/shutdown inhibitor is the only operational addition.
approval.confirmation_reference: After the V1R reboot interruption, exact partial counts, missing seal, full-recompute option, cost and unchanged scientific contract were reported; the user replied '批准'.

raw_sources: Ten C09 graph, spline, native mesh and geometry documents frozen by the read-only contract manifest.
The sealed C08 V8R evidence file at artifacts/evidence_sha256.txt.
excluded_sources: The interrupted gate4_20260817_cano_c09_route_conditioned_geometry_qualification_v1r_seed0 directory and every artifact under it.
All C10 strict-test worlds, model outputs, graph replays, planner outputs and M-TARE data.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local C09 validation geometry qualification only; no model selection, training, C10, planner or M-TARE use.

sampling.rule: Unchanged exact doubled-edge routes; preserve every frame, 1331 window memberships and 14502 bitwise-exact exterior poses; three resolutions are repeated audits, not new samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Support is the current traversal spline z plus sealed fta_distance_m with incident-edge-only C1 blending in windows.
teacher.valid_mask: Every frame must pass horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m and up>=0.8m at 0.10/0.05/0.025m.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model or planner consumes V1R2; PASS restores only C09 frozen-replay eligibility.

split.historical_pollution_audit: C09 was used for M1D checkpoint selection, so later replay is frozen graph-builder transfer validation, not strict end-to-end unseen generalization. C08 and C10 are declared but read zero times here.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only under 4 GiB address-space cap. Interrupted V1R evidence indicates roughly 8-12 active hours if uninterrupted; the formal cap remains 24 active hours. Zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 71 windows, 2054 arc endpoints, 639 patches, ten trajectories, one 15833-row audit and complete hashes.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Ten complete XY/XZ/safety figures and all per-layer patch integrity metrics.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, ambiguity, merge, seam failure, exterior pose change, safety failure, resource breach or process interruption seals or records FAIL; no retry, resume or partial reuse.
